It allows developers to leverage monadic operations on type-level information, enabling safe and modular input validation without relying on standard library dependencies. Additionally, it supports the definition of custom transformation rules and provides mechanisms to handle different input formats (like JSON or TOML) through a consistent programming paradigm.
